newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil lower house approves civil service reform.
newsitem.headline: Brazil lower house approves civil service reform.

text.p: Brazil's lower house Wednesday approved by the minimum of 308 votes a bill reforming the civil service, according to the vote count on the electronic board.
Officials said that because of the tightness of the vote, there would be a manual count to verify the result.
It was the first of two ballots on reform in the lower house.
One hundred and forty seven deputies voted against and 19 abstained, according to the electronic voting board.
The tally was later revised to 309 votes in favor and 18 abstentions in a manual count.
The civil service reform, which must pass through one more vote in the Chamber of Deputies and then twice through the Senate, is considered crucial to cutting Brazil's public sector deficit.
